decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly build up devotion to green by playing a heavy amount of green permanents, allowing you to take advantage of powerful green devotion-based cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Invasion of Ixalan. By ramping up with Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Wolfwillow Haven, you can quickly cast big threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll to overwhelm your opponent. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival provide additional card advantage and help maintain pressure on your opponent.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on putting early pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures and removal spells. The deck includes cards that can quickly deal damage and disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also having some resilience against control decks with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive threats and removal spells, while maintaining card advantage and tempo to secure victory in the early-to-mid game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board through removal spells and disruption while generating card advantage with powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck also aims to outvalue opponents with additional cards from Yorion, Sky Nomad as its companion. The land base is designed to support both black and blue mana requirements while also providing utility with cards like Field of Ruin and Castle Locthwain. Overall, the deck seeks to outlast opponents and establish dominance in the long game with its control elements.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disruption and aggressive creature plays to control the board and pressure the opponent. Utilizing Thoughtseize, Duress, and removal spells like Go for the Throat and Fatal Push, it aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying fast threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Blade of the Oni. The deck also includes powerful late-game threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to maintain pressure. With a mix of creatures, removal, and disruption, this deck aims to win through aggressive and efficient plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing a large variety of control spells and removal to dominate the game, while also taking advantage of card draw effects like Narset, Parter of Veils and Tinybones Joins Up to maintain card advantage. It also includes powerful finishers like The Meathook Massacre and Hopeless Nightmare to close out games. The mana base is carefully constructed to provide a good balance between black and blue sources, while also including utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Locthwain. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds additional value and flexibility to the deck.

The main concept of this Pioneer Merfolk Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively build a board presence using low-cost creatures like Silvergill Adept and Triton Shorestalker, supported by disruption spells like Fatal Push. The deck also focuses on controlling the opponent's resources with cards like Unholy Annex and Ritual Chamber while maintaining card advantage with Moon-Circuit Hacker. The unique addition of Kaito, Bane of Nightmares adds a powerful finisher to the deck, allowing for a swift victory against opponents.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast, low-cost creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, along with spells like Reckless Rage and Infuriate, the deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently. The deck also includes powerful lands like Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance to provide additional aggression and utility. Overall, the key strategy is to apply constant pressure and outpace the opponent to secure a victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive early game plays to pressure the opponent and disrupt their game plan. It utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Torch the Tower to control the board while deploying threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game quickly. Thoughtseize and Duress are included to disrupt the opponent's hand and keep them off-balance. The deck also includes some versatile cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fear of Missing Out to maintain card advantage and apply constant pressure.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements such as board wipes, removal spells, and counter magic to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage through cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Tinybones Joins Up. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a powerful companion that can provide additional value by flickering permanents for extra ETB effects. The mana base is designed to support the control game plan with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistency and flexibility in handling different matchups.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays, utilizing cards like Monstrous Rage and Burst Lightning to deal damage to opponents. The deck also includes cards like Snakeskin Veil and Soul-Scar Mage to protect and control the board. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy, with a mix of dual lands and basic lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors. With a focus on speed and aggression, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. It aims to disrupt the opponent's hand with hand disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize while deploying threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Unstoppable Slasher to apply pressure. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Archfiend of the Dross provides additional threats that can quickly close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through disruption and aggression to secure a quick victory.

This aggressive Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly applying pressure to the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells. The deck includes powerful cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to quickly close out games. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast threats and disrupt their strategy, ultimately leading to victory.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays using low-cost creatures and spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Heartfire Hero, and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to apply pressure early in the game. Reckless Rage and Fatal Push provide removal options to clear the opponent's board and make way for attacks. The inclusion of burn spells like Infuriate and Monstrous Rage allows for extra reach and damage potential. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast-paced aggression and efficient card synergies.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing various removal spells and disruptive cards to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also aims to generate card advantage through effects like Narset, Parter of Veils and Tinybones Joins Up. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value by flickering permanents. The mana base is optimized to support the control strategy with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistent access to both blue and black mana sources.

This deck focuses on assembling combos by discovering key pieces through card draw and ramp. Utilizing Leyline Binding and Greater Tanuki for control, with Quintorius Kand and Gyruda, Doom of Depths providing payoff for the combo pieces. Spark Double and Clever Impersonator can copy important creatures, while Virtue of Persistence helps to protect them. The mana base is varied to ensure the right colors are available when needed. Overall, the strategy is to search for and assemble powerful combos to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand while utilizing the powerful creature Niv-Mizzet Reborn to generate card advantage and gain control of the game. The deck includes a variety of powerful multicolor lands and spells to ensure consistent mana fixing and versatile answers to a wide range of threats. The companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value and card advantage, while cards like Leyline Binding and Bring to Light help to disrupt the opponent's strategy and provide answers to problematic permanents.
